fieldData.acrm---integration-feature-4:
A reporter on a 48-hour deadline gets a direct line

Reporters writing about Northwind use the get in touch form on its press page. It asks for the outlet, the story and the deadline. A deadline within 48 hours sends a direct Slack message to Jonah Reyes, the communications lead. Later deadlines join a press queue he reviews each Monday.

fieldData.awb---how-to-description: Decide who answers before you decide what to ask. The fields follow from the people on the other end.
fieldData.awb---how-to-step-2-des: Ask everyone for a name, an email address and the message. Add a phone field only when a person will call back. Every required field you add is one more thing a visitor has to fill in before they can send.
fieldData.afb---how-to-step-5-des: Write your topics and their owners into one prompt in plain English, with the fields and reply windows. Emergent builds the form, the rules that route each message and a table where every message is stored. Change any owner later by prompting again.
fieldData.afb---prompt: Build a contact form for my website that sends each topic to the right person.

acrm---key-feature-4-image.alt: A reporter's inquiry with a deadline 36 hours away matches the 48-hour rule and goes to the communications lead as a direct Slack message.
